_readme: Human-owned. Agents cannot edit agentops/. Percentages are of YOUR WHOLE Claude plan (all your work), not just this team.

usage._readme: Owner limits: the team starts a run only if session (5-hour) usage plus the run's expected size stays under five_hour_stop_pct, and weekly usage under seven_day_stop_pct; a run that reaches a limit is stopped. Set them with `agents limits --session 96` (saved in ~/.claude/agentops/config.local.json). Usage is read live from Claude (includes your claude.ai use). safety_margin/snapshot/uncalibrated keys apply only when no live reading is possible.

idle._readme: Agents only run when you are not using Claude Code yourself: no activity in any of your other Claude Code sessions for `quiet_minutes`.

schedule._readme: mode 'on-demand': agents work only after you run `agents start` (until `agents stop`, or for --hours / --until). mode 'always': any time inside allowed_hours (local time, 24h, comma-separated). Both modes are still idle- and usage-gated.

workers._readme: How many agents work at the same time on each plan, each in its own copy of the repo (set with `agents workers --claude 2 --gpt 2`). claude: 1-3, codex: 0-3 (0 moves the GPT roles back to Claude).

run._max_budget_readme: Per-run size cap using Claude Code's client-side cost ESTIMATE. On a subscription you are not billed this; it just stops runaway runs.
run._continuous_readme: Each scheduled check keeps the agents busy until tick_hard_limit_minutes: a worker that finds nothing to do looks again every poll_minutes; one held back by limits every gated_poll_minutes. A run starts only if the check has min_run_minutes_by_action left, and only if Ubuntu has min_free_memory_mb free while other agents run.
run._failover_readme: When one plan (Claude or ChatGPT) is at your limit, its roles run on the other engine instead of waiting, and switch back by themselves when their own plan has room again. heartbeat_minutes: how often the team's state is written to the heartbeat issue on GitHub (0 = off).

paths._readme: Personal overrides (any key in this file) go in ~/.claude/agentops/config.local.json — it survives the agents clone reset.

engines._readme: Codex lane: roles with engine 'codex' run on the Codex CLI (your ChatGPT plan) in a second copy of the repo, at the same time as the Claude lane. It switches on only after `agents codex-check` passes.

roles._readme: Which engine and model runs each agent. Roles not listed run on Claude Code with the model in their .claude/agents file.
